flagged.evidence: The Statement defines the map as “Tχ(x,p)=(x,p+e∇χ(x))”. Its dependency, def-csm-static-gauge-coupled-particle-model, says the paired change is “Tχ(x,p)=(x,p+q_p∇χ(x))” and specifies that q_p is distinct from e and arbitrary. For q_p=0 and nonconstant χ, the model Hamiltonian is unchanged by the gauge transformation, but the stated Tχ shifts p by e∇χ and does not carry the canonical density to itself. The proof uses q_p, so it does not establish the map stated.
